sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders will be looking to bounce back from their most recent defeat, though their underlying form remains strong with seven wins from their last ten outings. Alsager are bottom of the league with just four points and arrive in poor form, having won only once in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Stafford's superior points tally (20 vs 11) reflecting their stronger campaign so far. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, face Eccleshall at home—both clubs are among the division's form teams, though Eccleshall's recent resurgence (winning four of their last five) makes this a competitive clash. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in an encounter between fifth and ninth places; Casuals arrive in fine form with three consecutive wins. Bilston Town, sixth in the table, visit Foley Meir in a battle between mid-tier sides. Barnton travel to Shawbury United in a contest between teams separated by just five points, though Barnton hold the edge with stronger recent form. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town, a clash between teams in the lower half; Market Drayton have won three of their last five but remain vulnerable. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, with both sides fighting for respectability in the lower reaches of the table. Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social in a fixture between two struggling sides—Widnes are adrift at the bottom with just two points from seven games. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a crucial fixture at the wrong end of the table, with both teams among the division's lowest scorers.
